basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old graphic designer based in Seattle, passionate about exploring the boundaries between art and technology. In my free time, I enjoy diving into the world of subliminal messages and how they can be used for self-improvement. I have a penchant for public domain music as it provides a unique backdrop for my creative processes. I mostly browse Reddit during evenings after work, looking for new insights and connecting with like-minded individuals. Currently single, I enjoy the freedom to explore various hobbies and interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: While I have a formal education in graphic design, I have a keen interest in subliminal messaging, which I've explored through self-teaching and community discussions. Gaming has been a long-time hobby, where I've developed strategic thinking and a keen eye for detail.
